value.rationale: The maximal-diagonal-torus locus is a natural positive-dimensional special family in the moduli of pairs of twisted cubics; its exact degeneration of ten enumerative common secants into the scheme \(3+4+3\) records where and with what local algebra all solutions collide. The two tangent contributions and the length-four noncomplete-collision chord are structurally distinct; the global 10-count cannot recover this distribution. This provides concrete boundary geometry relevant to algebraic continuation of the common-secant problem, not a routine arbitrary numerical slice.
